data.text: Welcome, Luke. I’d favor ten tons each this month, with a firm fifty-ton total so the lake can replenish. My family’s fished here for years, and keeping it healthy protects everyone’s livelihood. If you want a larger share, we can discuss voluntary swaps, but nobody should have to give up their share or risk the lake. Shall we agree to that limit and review our catches together each month? John, what do you think?
